title: Prior Late Fees Counted on a Patient Payment Plan
content:
**Patient Financial Services policy — the late fees already booked on a Patient Payment Plan, as counted for a missed-installment late fee**

When a missed-installment late fee is set on a Patient Payment Plan, the late fees already booked on the plan are counted over a period that follows the plan's record:

(a) for a plan signed at least 12 whole months before the handling date with no more than 2 installments recorded as missed within the last 12 months, only the late fees on installments within the last 12 months are counted;

(b) for a plan signed at least 12 whole months before the handling date with more than 2 installments recorded as missed within the last 12 months, the late fees on installments within the last 24 months are counted;

(c) for any other plan, the late fees of the plan's whole life are counted.

**Placing an entry in time.** A date falls within the last N months when fewer than N whole calendar months separate it from the handling date. An installment, and a late fee on it, is placed by the installment's due date; any other entry by the date it was recorded. A plan's age is the number of whole calendar months from the date the agreement was signed to the handling date.

## Decision table

| Plan signed at least 12 whole months before the handling date | Installments recorded as missed within the last 12 months | Late fees counted |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 0, 1 or 2 | Those on installments due within the last 12 months |
| Yes | 3 or more | Those on installments due within the last 24 months |
| No (fewer than 12 whole months) | Any number | Every late fee of the plan's whole life |

## Boundary readings (hypothetical dates, handling date 2026-09-20)

- **Plan age.** Signed 2025-09-20: 12 whole months, so the plan is "at least 12 whole months" old. Signed 2025-09-21: 11 whole months, so row three applies.
- **Inside the last 12 months.** An installment due 2025-09-21 is 11 whole months before the handling date and falls within the last 12 months; one due 2025-09-20 is 12 whole months before and does not.
- **Missed-installment threshold.** With 2 installments recorded as missed in the last 12 months the plan is in the first row; with 3 it is in the second.

## Worked case (hypothetical)

A plan signed 20 months before the handling date has late fees on installments due 4, 9 and 15 months before the handling date, and 1 installment recorded as missed within the last 12 months. Row one applies: the late fees on installments due within the last 12 months are counted, which gives a count of 2.
